title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Gloucester
Working Pattern: Hybrid

A great opportunity has arisen for an Accounts Assistant to join a busy finance team based in central Gloucester.

The role will support the wider finance function across Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, including processing invoices, managing payments, reconciliations and dealing with supplier and customer queries.

Key Responsibilities:
- Supporting day-to-day AP and AR processes
- Processing invoices and payments
- Account and bank reconciliations
- Managing supplier and customer queries
- Supporting the wider finance team with general duties

About You:
- Previous AP and/or AR experience
- Good attention to detail
- Confident working with Excel and finance systems
- Organised and able to manage deadlines
- Good communication skills

Salary: £26,000-£27,000 + hybrid working.

title: Accounts Payable Clerk
description:
Accounts Payable Clerk

Location: Gloucester (office-based)
Hours: Full-time or part-time considered, including school hours
Duration: Temporary contract until approximately Christmas
Salary: Up to £15ph

An established business is seeking an experienced Purchase Ledger Assistant to support a busy finance team during a period of increased workload.

Working within a high-volume accounts environment, responsibilities will include:
- Processing a large volume of supplier invoices
- Matching invoices against purchase orders
- Nominal coding and VAT checks
- Supplier statement reconciliations
- Investigating and resolving invoice queries
- Assisting with payment run preparation
- Liaising with suppliers and internal departments

The successful candidate will have previous Purchase Ledger experience and be comfortable managing a busy workload with a high level of accuracy. Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently are essential.

Requirements:
- Proven Purchase Ledger experience
- Experience with high-volume invoice processing
- Confidence with statement reconciliations
- Strong organisational and communication skills
- Ability to quickly adapt to new systems and processes

This is an excellent opportunity to join a friendly and supportive finance team and make an immediate impact.

Immediate start available. Interviews taking place ASAP.

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
Are you strongest in Paid Social or Paid Search and looking for a role where you can see the impact of your campaigns? Would you like to combine performance marketing with hands-on organic social content?

We're working with a successful, family-run British fashion and lifestyle brand based in Gloucestershire. The business has grown into a distinctive name, with colourful collections inspired by art, craft and the natural world. Its ranges are designed in-house and stocked by more than 300 retailers across the UK and Europe. The brand is now building on that established retail presence by continuing to grow its eCommerce channel and invest in its digital marketing team.

The Role

You'll join the digital marketing team to manage campaigns across Meta and Google, working closely with stakeholders to create dynamic, engaging ads. The paid media split will be around 70% Meta and 30% Google, so experience across both would be great. If you specialise in either Paid Social or Paid Search, though, we'd still love to hear from you.

Alongside paid campaigns, you'll have the opportunity to work with the social team on producing and publishing organic content across Meta platforms. It's a hands-on role that brings together campaign performance, creative thinking and social content.

Skills and Experience
- Hands-on experience managing campaigns in Meta Ads or Google Ads; experience across both would be an advantage.
- An understanding of how to monitor campaign results and use data to improve performance.
- An interest in creative testing, audience targeting and developing engaging ads.
- Comfortable working with stakeholders and collaborating across digital and social teams.
- An interest in organic social content and willingness to help produce and publish posts.
- A proactive, organised approach and the confidence to get involved across different areas of digital marketing.

Benefits

The salary is £34,000 - £40,000, with the chance to build on your experience in Paid Social or Paid Search, broaden your knowledge of the other channel and contribute to organic social content. You'll be part of a growing in-house digital team, working on campaigns for a successful fashion eCommerce brand.

Sound Good?

If you have hands-on experience in either Meta Ads or Google Ads and like the idea of combining paid campaigns with organic social, we'd love to hear from you. Click the apply button to send Tonic your CV.

title: Personal Assistant
company: Gloucestershire Health and Care NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Gloucestershire Health and Care NHS Foundation Trust
description: This role is offered on a fixed term/secondment basis for up to 12 months. The hours are part-time, 22.5 hours per week. *Internal applicants who wish to be considered for a secondment opportunity should discuss with their line manager the suitability of a possible secondment* The role is based within the Child and Adolescent Mental Health Service(CAMHS) at its Gloucester site, however it may be necessary for the post holder to travel, on an infrequent basis, to other sites within Gloucestershire to support at times of staff shortages etc. Take responsibility for operational management tasks as delegated by CAMHS Support Services Lead. To provide a full confidential, administrative and secretarial service to the CYPS Service Director (including wider CAMHS Management as requested) To work as a member of the wider PA team to ensure service delivery and adequate PA cover is provided To project the professional image of the business through demonstrating excellent customer care in all activities To adopt a constantly flexible approach to ensure that objectives are completed efficiently and within given timescales To maintain confidentiality at all times To provide comprehensive and efficient secretarial and personal assistant support ensuring the accurate and timely production of work to a high standard. Word processing, audio-typing, production of letters, documents, tables, presentations using Microsoft Office programmes (Word, PowerPoint and Excel in particular). Complex and frequently changing diary management using Microsoft Outlook. Booking and arranging travel, transport and accommodation. Setting up and using multi-media technology such as MS Team. Provide formal reports regarding the analysis of CAMHS information (this may include some statistical analysis). Receive and make telephone calls, taking messages, dealing with telephone and email enquiries appropriately and ensuring accurate and timely communication of messages. Log and prioritise post, taking appropriate action and responding as required. Communicate with a variety of people on a range of matters and keep accurate and complete records consistent with the Trusts policies and procedures. Provide and receive complex and sensitive information to work colleagues and clients using tact and diplomacy. Be responsible for organising meetings, conferences and workshops including preparation of agendas, arranging venues and hospitality and ensuring follow-up actions are initiated and arranged. Support Board level meetings by comprehensive minute taking. Maintaining accurate and efficient filing systems, both electronically and on paper, ensuring strict confidentiality of client/staff identifiable information. Providing support for routine HR procedures e.g. recruitment and selection, annual leave, as delegated by CAMHS Management. Assist in collating tenders for the procurement of goods and services and ensuring that relevant documentation of the procedures are completed. Maintaining awareness of strategic developments within the Trust. Sourcing information for the Director on key initiatives/developments nationally and locally. Assist in ordering and maintaining stationery stock, office equipment and other physical assets as required. Undertake any other appropriate duties as may be delegated from time to time. Be able to work to deadlines as required by the service needs. Actively participate in team meetings and discussions with colleagues and managers to make constructive suggestions as to how services could be improved with own work area and implementing such changes with guidance from line manager. Acts in ways that support equality and value diversity. Treat everyone with whom you come in contact with dignity and respect and recognise and report behaviour that undermines equality and diversity. This role is not eligible for sponsorship as per the Governments UK VISA and Immigration Rules and Regulations.
